attributes.title: 2027 Oklahoma Veterinary Conference
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Norman Hotel & Conference Center
attributes.summary:
The Oklahoma VMA's next Oklahoma Veterinary Conference is set for April 15 to 17, 2027, in Norman, Oklahoma. The save-the-date lists 21 CE hours and names veterinarians, technicians, practice managers and veterinary students as the audience.

The meeting is at the Embassy Suites by Hilton Norman Hotel & Conference Center, where the group room rate is $130 a night. Registration is open: a complete conference pass costs $430 for OVMA member veterinarians and $700 for non-members, $255 for OVTA member technicians ($280 for non-members) and $220 for practice staff of OVMA members; veterinary and technician students attend free. OVMA notes that early-bird pricing is reflected on the registration form. Any RACE approval is not published yet.
